issues.title: add link from dsAutomation0 domain to dsAutomationHistory0 domain
issues.author: anewton1998
issues.body: Create a link relationship and a link requirement from a dsAutomation0 domain to a disAutomationHistory0 domain

issues.title: history should be in array
issues.author: anewton1998
issues.body: the dsData and keyData are modeled incorrectly in dsAutomationHistory0. It assumes no change in the actual dsData or keyData. Unfortunately, this needs to change to a format that isn't compliant with RFC9083 but we can borrow bits and pieces to help with code re-use.

issues.title: history should include all events
issues.author: anewton1998
issues.body:
The current wording seems to exclude other events on the dsData and keyData. it should include all events.
We also need to state that the party attesting to "ds automation *" will either be the registry or the registrar. Probably need better examples.

comments.author: peterthomassen
comments.body: How do we bound the log length? Or is pagination intended?

comments.author: anewton1998
comments.body:
The current text says all events since the registration of the domain. This is likely too much. I think an algorithm is probably better, such as to the last removal or the last 3 updates up to instantiation. I don't know what is right. The big issue is that most operators will not keep this information in their "live" database, especially the deletion.

There is a pagination extension for RDAP, but I don't think any client or production server has implemented it. And I don't want to go there. If we have to do pagination, I think we have a problem.
